description_en: You can invoke TakeBreak to set a specified agent in a specified instance to the break state
description_zh: 调用TakeBreak将指定实例下的指定坐席设置为小休状态
kebab_example: aliyun ccc take-break --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id device --code lunchtime --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TakeBreak

parameters.help_en: Agent ID. If not specified, the agent mapped to the current RAM account is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID，不填默认使用当前RAM账户映射的坐席
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled with any value
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: Break status code. Customers can define any custom break status
parameters.help_zh: 小休状态码，客户可以自定义任何小休状态
parameters.name: code
